prompt: 請幫我分析今天收盤後的台股信號，並挑選出適合明天買進與關注的前五檔股票清單，包含K線、籌碼、近期新聞等深度分析報告。請以設計精美、便於人類閱讀的 HTML 網頁格式 (watch_list_analysis.html) 輸出。

assertions.name: selects_5_stocks
assertions.description: Verify that exactly 5 stocks are selected as the top recommended stocks.

assertions.name: excludes_3481
assertions.description: Verify that 3481 (Innolux) is excluded from the top 5 watchlist.

assertions.name: excludes_2324
assertions.description: Verify that 2324 (Compal) is excluded from the top 5 watchlist.

assertions.name: includes_suggested_prices
assertions.description: Verify that entry, TP, and SL prices are provided for the recommended stocks.
